subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Spontaneous
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3, i.e., Instinctive.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **Spontaneous**, which means occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse or inclination and without premeditation or external stimulus. 
 
• The correct option, **Instinctive**, means relating to or prompted by instinct; apparently unconscious or automatic.

- Therefore, the correct answer is- Instinctive.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Attractive** means pleasing or appealing to the senses. 
 
• **Exhaustive** means thorough and complete in execution. 
 
• **Acquisitive** means excessively interested in acquiring money or material things.
